column1: # ESP-IDF partition table for ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 (16MB flash).
# Sized generously since 16MB gives ample headroom versus the 2MB module
# used in the prior port attempt -- the app partition alone here is larger
# NOT currently wired into build/build_firmware.sh: lvgl_micropython's
# build system auto-generates its own partition table from --flash-size
# rather than accepting this file directly (confirmed during Phase 1
# bring-up -- the real built firmware's app partition ended up ~2.9MB
# close to but not exactly this file's 0x300000/3MB `factory` size
# is already down to a few hundred bytes free). Revisit once firmware
# size becomes a real constraint (see build_firmware.sh's "Known
# `--custom-board-path`/`--toml` mechanism rather than this raw CSV.
